1: // Minimal Orbit Dodge game
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
8:   // audio setup
9:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
10:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
11:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     osc.type = 'sine';
14:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
15:     osc.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
18:     osc.start();
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
20:   }
21:   // generate simple starfield background
22:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 120 }, () => ({
23:     x: Math.random() * W,
24:     y: Math.random() * H,
25:     r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
26:   }));
27: 
28:   const planet = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, r: 30 };
29: 
30:   const player = {
31:     angle: 0,
32:     radius: planet.r + 50,
33:     size: 8,
34:     speed: 0.03, // angular speed per frame
35:     thrust: 0.5, // radial speed per frame when thrusting
36:     minOrbit: planet.r + 20,
37:     maxOrbit: Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 20,
38:   };
39: 
40:   const asteroids = [];
41:   const powerUps = [];
42:   let gameOver = false;
43:   let score = 0;
44: 
45:   // Utility
46:   const rand = (a, b) => Math.random() * (b - a) + a;
47: 
48:   function spawnAsteroid() {
49:     const side = Math.floor(rand(0, 4)); // 0:top 1:right 2:bottom 3:left
50:     let x, y, vx, vy;
51:     const speed = rand(1, 3);
52:     if (side === 0) { x = rand(0, W); y = -20; vx = rand(-1, 1); vy = speed; }
53:     else if (side === 1) { x = W + 20; y = rand(0, H); vx = -speed; vy = rand(-1, 1); }
54:     else if (side === 2) { x = rand(0, W); y = H + 20; vx = rand(-1, 1); vy = -speed; }
55:     else { x = -20; y = rand(0, H); vx = speed; vy = rand(-1, 1); }
56:     const r = rand(5, 12);
57:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r });
58:   }
59: 
60:   function spawnPowerUp() {
61:     const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
62:     const radius = rand(player.minOrbit + 30, player.maxOrbit - 30);
63:     const x = planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
64:     const y = planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
65:     powerUps.push({ x, y, r: 6, collected: false });
66:   }
67: 
68:   // Input handling
69:   const keys = {};
70:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
71:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
72: 
73:   function update() {
74:     if (gameOver) return;
75:     // player controls
76:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) player.angle -= player.speed;
77:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) player.angle += player.speed;
78:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
79:       player.radius = Math.min(player.radius + player.thrust, player.maxOrbit);
80:       playTone(300, 0.05); // thrust sound
81:     }
82:     // simple gravity pull towards planet if not thrusting
83:     player.radius = Math.max(player.radius - 0.1, player.minOrbit);
84: 
85:     // move asteroids
86:     asteroids.forEach(a => { a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy; });
87:     // remove off‑screen asteroids
88:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
89:       const a = asteroids[i];
90:       if (a.x < -50 || a.x > W + 50 || a.y < -50 || a.y > H + 50) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
91:     }
92:     // collision detection
93:     const px = planet.x + Math.cos(player.angle) * player.radius;
94:     const py = planet.y + Math.sin(player.angle) * player.radius;
95:     // planet collision
96:     if (player.radius - player.size <= planet.r) {
97:       gameOver = true;
98:       playTone(100, 0.3); // crash sound
99:     }
100:     // asteroid collisions
101:     for (const a of asteroids) {
102:       const dx = px - a.x, dy = py - a.y;
103:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < a.r + player.size) {
104:         gameOver = true;
105:         playTone(100, 0.3);
106:         break;
107:       }
108:     }
109:     // power‑up collection
110:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
111:       const p = powerUps[i];
112:       const d = Math.hypot(px - p.x, py - p.y);
113:       if (d < p.r + player.size) {
114:         player.minOrbit += 5; // expand safe orbit radius
115:         player.maxOrbit = Math.min(player.maxOrbit + 5, Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 20);
116:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
117:         score += 10;
118:       }
119:     }
120:     // spawn logic
121:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
122:     if (Math.random() < 0.005) spawnPowerUp();
123:     score += 0.01;
124:   }
125: 
126:   function draw() {
127:     // dark space background
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#02010a';
129:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
130:     // starfield
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
132:     for (const s of stars) {
133:       ctx.beginPath();
134:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
135:       ctx.fill();
136:     }
137:     // planet with gradient
138:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
139:       planet.x, planet.y, planet.r * 0.2,
140:       planet.x, planet.y, planet.r
141:     );
142:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#666');
143:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#111');
144:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
145:     ctx.beginPath();
146:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
147:     ctx.fill();
148:     // player ship as triangle with slight shadow
149:     const px = planet.x + Math.cos(player.angle) * player.radius;
150:     const py = planet.y + Math.sin(player.angle) * player.radius;
151:     const shipAngle = player.angle + Math.PI / 2; // point outward
152:     const shipSize = player.size * 2;
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
154:     ctx.beginPath();
155:     ctx.moveTo(
156:       px + Math.cos(shipAngle) * shipSize,
157:       py + Math.sin(shipAngle) * shipSize
158:     );
159:     ctx.lineTo(
160:       px + Math.cos(shipAngle + Math.PI * 2 / 3) * shipSize * 0.6,
161:       py + Math.sin(shipAngle + Math.PI * 2 / 3) * shipSize * 0.6
162:     );
163:     ctx.lineTo(
164:       px + Math.cos(shipAngle - Math.PI * 2 / 3) * shipSize * 0.6,
165:       py + Math.sin(shipAngle - Math.PI * 2 / 3) * shipSize * 0.6
166:     );
167:     ctx.closePath();
168:     ctx.fill();
169:     // asteroids with subtle gradient
170:     for (const a of asteroids) {
171:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
172:         a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3,
173:         a.x, a.y, a.r
174:       );
175:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#c44');
176:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#822');
177:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
178:       ctx.beginPath();
179:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
180:       ctx.fill();
181:     }
182:     // power‑ups with glow
183:     for (const p of powerUps) {
184:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
185:         p.x, p.y, p.r * 0.2,
186:         p.x, p.y, p.r * 2
187:       );
188:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
189:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,165,0,0)');
190:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
191:       ctx.beginPath();
192:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
193:       ctx.fill();
194:     }
195:     // UI overlay
196:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
197:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
198:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
199:     if (gameOver) {
200:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
201:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
202:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
203:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
204:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
205:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
206:     }
207:   }
208:     // power‑ups
209:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
210:     for (const p of powerUps) {
211:       ctx.beginPath();
212:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
213:       ctx.fill();
214:     }
215:     // UI
216:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
217:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
218:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
219:     if (gameOver) {
220:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';

227:   }
228: 
229:   function loop() {
230:     update();
231:     draw();
232:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
233:   }

236: })();
